title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Program Rule on Accounts Held per Customer
content:
**Rule.** Under Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards a customer may hold at most 2 card accounts at the same time, and at most one of them on each network: one private-label account (Marlowe & Finch Store Card, Store Card Plus or Store Card Elite) and one co-brand account (Marlowe & Finch Mastercard, Platinum Mastercard or World Elite Mastercard). The network of a card is its card network, and only a card accepted on the Mastercard network can be used outside Marlowe & Finch.

**What counts as held.** An account counts as held while its status is applied, active or restricted; closed, charged-off and declined accounts do not count.

**Condition on a new application.** The customer holds no other card account of the same network in applied, active or restricted status. This is read from the company's card account records for that customer (the customer's account, its card and its status) before the application is taken; it is not taken from the customer's own account of what she or he holds.

**Consequences.**

1. When the customer already holds an account on the requested network, a new application is not taken. Moving up that network's ladder happens only through the status review; moving to the other network is a new application for the other network's card.
2. A customer with a charged-off card account whose closed date (the charge-off date) is within 84 full calendar months before the application date is not taken for any card.

## Decision table for a new application

| Held on the requested network (applied, active or restricted) | Charged-off account closed within 84 full calendar months before the application date | Application taken |
|---|---|---|
| none | none | the rule above sets no bar |
| one | none | no |
| none | yes | no, for any card |
| one | yes | no |

## Cases (hypothetical customers)

- A customer holds an active Marlowe & Finch Store Card and asks to apply for the Marlowe & Finch Mastercard. The Mastercard is on the other network, so the held Store Card is no bar; the request is a new application for the co-brand card.
- A customer holds a restricted Marlowe & Finch Mastercard and asks to apply for the World Elite Mastercard. A restricted account counts as held on the co-brand network, so the application is not taken.
- A customer's only earlier account was charged off and closed 30 full calendar months before the application date: the application is not taken for any card. Had it been closed 90 full calendar months before, the 84-month bar would not apply.
- A customer's earlier Store Card was closed at her own request; a closed account does not count as held.
